sources.title: WHO recommendations on antenatal care for a positive pregnancy experience: executive summary (2016)

items.notes: Confirmed by ROP and FCDO in A2-4. GOV.OM portal also shows 9999 as general emergency. App already shows 9999 — consistent.

content.en: No Oman Ministry of Health specific pregnancy vaccination schedule was found in this pass. Oman gave COVID vaccines to pregnant women (2021). International recommendation: Tdap in every pregnancy (27-36 weeks); flu annually.
content.ar: لم نجد جدول تطعيم الحوامل الرسمي من وزارة الصحة العُمانية. تُوصي المعايير الدولية بـ Tdap في كل حمل (27-36 أسبوعًا) والإنفلونزا سنويًا.

items.notes: Only COVID vaccine in pregnancy sources found (2021); no routine Tdap or RSV maternal guidance page found.
items.reviewerMustSupply: Omani obstetrician or MOH maternal vaccine page.

content.en: No Oman Ministry of Health antenatal appointment schedule was found in this pass. WHO recommends a minimum of eight contacts.
content.ar: لم نجد جدول مواعيد رسمي من وزارة الصحة العُمانية. منظمة الصحة العالمية توصي بما لا يقل عن 8 زيارات.

items.reviewerMustSupply: Omani obstetrician or MOH maternal health page.

items.topic: folic acid and iron in pregnancy

content.en: No Oman Ministry of Health specific supplement recommendation was found in this pass. WHO recommends folic acid 400 mcg and iron 30-60 mg daily.
content.ar: لم نجد توصية عُمانية بجرعة محددة. منظمة الصحة العالمية توصي بحمض الفوليك 400 ميكروغرام والحديد 30-60 ملغ يوميًا.

content.en: The Oman Pharmacy and Drug Directorate (Ministry of Health) regulates medicines. Its pregnancy/breastfeeding information pages were not read in this pass.
content.ar: مديرية الصيدلة والدواء (وزارة الصحة العُمانية) تنظم الأدوية. لم تُقرأ صفحاتها في هذه المرحلة.
